chunks: Those who were mindful of their duty to their Lord will be driven in groups to Paradise, till they reach it and its gates are opened, and its keepers say to them: 'Peace be on you; you are the joyous. So enter here to live for ever.'

key_terms.الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا: Those who were mindful of their duty to their Lord (the God-conscious)

ai.seo_question: How do the righteous enter Paradise according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the communal nature of salvation, where the *muttaqun* enter Paradise in groups, reflecting the concept of *Tawassul* through the righteous. The greeting 'Tabtum' (you have become good/pure) signifies the culmination of their spiritual purification, while the eternal residence underscores the permanence of divine grace for those who maintained God-consciousness.
